Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Q2 inference priorities

Hi Sarah & Tom,

Thanks again for the time earlier — really helpful to walk through Acme's Q2 goals around product personalization and checkout latency. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Key points I heard:
- Target: reduce inference p99 for personalization calls from ~450ms to <150ms for 2k RPS by end of Q2
- Data: models will run on customer traffic with PII-filtering; logs need 30d retention and auditability
- Constraints: Procurement requires SOC2 + IP Addendum; procurement owner likely Tom (cc'd)

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached a short recording of the demo and a draft Mutual Action Plan (RDW-Acme-MAP-v1.pdf) — please review
2) Tech deep dive with our infra lead (30–45m) to validate latency numbers and capacity needs (let me know availability)
3) Security checklist: I'll kick off the SOC2 evidence bundle if you want to move procurement forward
4) Pricing: I can share a draft quote once we confirm expected qps and retention needs

Ask: Is there a preferred procurement owner and an internal timeline for approvals? Understanding whether you still intend to onboard in April will help me prioritize capacity and any EoQ incentives.

I’ll follow up if I don’t hear back — want to make sure this stays on your radar as you finalize Q2 plans.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
